subject: Green New Deal and Climate Policy Proposals
overview: Anna Callahan presented her climate platform, advocating for an environmental justice approach to climate policy and outlining goals for renewable energy, zero-emission infrastructure, and legislative reform.

items.title: Environmental Justice and Coalition Building
items.summary: Anna Callahan stated that climate change requires an environmental justice approach driven by a coalition of marginalized communities, labor, and environmental groups.

items.title: Climate Infrastructure and Renewable Energy Targets
items.summary: Callahan proposed reaching 100% renewable electricity by 2035, divesting from fossil fuels, electrifying transportation, and requiring zero-emission standards for housing and commercial buildings.

items.title: Legislative Reform and State House Power Structure
items.summary: Callahan argued that while Massachusetts residents support climate initiatives, reform of the State House leadership structure is necessary to pass climate legislation.
